result.title: EvoMCP: Co-evolving MCP agents and training data
result.summary: Supervised fine-tuning of Model Context Protocol (MCP) agents is typically conducted on a static data distribution, which fails to adapt to the student's evolving capabilities and leaves newly exposed weaknesses insufficiently addressed. To address these challenges, we propose \method, an agent--data mutual evolution framework that enables MCP agents to improve through a closed loop of task evolution, trajectory evolution, and supervised fine-tuning. Specifically, \method\ assesses the student's established capabilities and capability gaps from rollout feedback to identify learning targets. Task evolution then translates these targets into executable tasks by adapting the instructions and observable environment states of compatible verified seed tasks while keeping their verifiers aligned. To provide reliable and efficient demonstrations for these tasks, trajectory evolution uses reusable skills to recover failed teacher rollouts and refine successful ones. The resulting task--trajectory pairs are used to fine-tune the student, while accepted tasks seed subsequent evolution. To close the loop, we re-evaluate the updated student and use its feedback to guide the next round of data evolution. Experiments on Toolathlon, MCPMark, and MCP-Atlas demonstrate consistent improvements over the initial student, yielding absolute gains of 16.5\%, 10.2\%, and 12.6\%, respectively. Project page: https://github.com/xagao/EvoMCP.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EvoMCP，一个 MCP agent 与训练数据互演化框架：依据 rollout 反馈评估学生的能力与缺口，据此演化任务指令与环境状态，再用可复用技能修复或精炼教师轨迹，闭环进行监督微调与再评估，在三个 MCP 基准上取得稳定提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按能力缺口生成任务 + 用可复用技能回收失败轨迹」的做法，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的数据筛选、失败样本利用与贡献分配提供可核查线索，但本身不涉及 latent 状态或视觉推理。
